children: The Page Industries-led campaign celebrates Jockey’s global legacy while highlighting its evolution from innerwear to a broader comfort-wear portfolio in India

Page Industries has launched Jockey’s 150 Years Young campaign in India, marking the brand’s 150-year global legacy and highlighting its evolution across categories, consumer segments and the wider comfort-wear market.
Anchored by the tagline Never Stopped. Never Will., the campaign focuses on Jockey’s continued emphasis on innovation, category expansion and relevance to changing consumer needs.

Founded in 1876 as S.T. Cooper & Sons, Jockey has evolved from a hosiery maker into a global comfort-wear brand available in more than 120 countries. In India, Page Industries has been the brand’s exclusive licensee since 1994, with Jockey now spanning more than three decades in the market.

The brand’s India portfolio has expanded beyond its traditional innerwear category to include athleisure, activewear and dedicated ranges for women, children and Gen Z consumers. Jockey is currently available across more than 100,000 retail doors in India, including over 1,500 exclusive brand outlets.

“150 years is a significant milestone for Jockey, yet it is just the beginning for us,” says Nihal Rajan, Chief Marketing Officer, Jockey India. “Jockey's India journey, over the last three decades has been shaped by a deep understanding of evolving consumer needs, translated into product innovation, category expansion and a strong manufacturing and retail ecosystem.

The ‘150 Years’ Campaign reflects a larger shift in how everyday wear is perceived from purely functional to deeply personal, with consumers seeking comfort that enables movement and self-expression. As innerwear and outerwear continue to converge, Jockey remains at the forefront of this shift, shaping how modern India experiences comfort in its most essential form.”

The campaign also highlights the role of manufacturing and vertically integrated operations in supporting Jockey’s product development and quality at scale. The brand is using its 150-year milestone to connect its legacy with its ongoing expansion across comfort-wear categories.

For Page Industries, the campaign provides an opportunity to reflect on the milestones that have shaped Jockey’s presence in India, from product and manufacturing capabilities to category expansion and its growing retail footprint.

With 150 Years Young, Jockey is positioning its heritage alongside its continued focus on evolving consumer needs, using the milestone to reinforce its proposition around comfort, innovation and everyday wear.
